# Independent validation of action-to-patch provenance
Observation on earlier three anchor submissions motivates this follow-up. Use all other public folders in the official SWE-bench-submissions bucket under bash-only/ whose subfolder name contains mini and whose logs and tool trajectories are identifiable via public listing. No selection by aggregate solve score or by mismatch evidence. Before reading other candidates' content, fix up to 24 different issues per eligible submission, lowest salted SHA256 ('public-link-audit-v1|folder|issue') among IDs with an evaluator patch.diff and a .traj.json. Report missing pairs by folder including incompatible layouts; do not interpret them as mismatches. For new folders only, count byte equality (nonempty on both sides), Git-style signed-lines equivalence, and recorded model name where available. For schema without a final submission string mark unknown, not different. Summarize independent submissions and sampled issues, distributions by folder, and detection rate among usable pairs, avoiding generalization to all leaderboards. Do not read official hidden test outcomes. Keep original compressed trace authenticated by ETag where strong and SHA-256, separate evaluator patch and trajectory-patch bytes, source URLs, stored model ids. This is a data linkage quality diagnostic, not evidence that either implementation is right or the submission score is wrong.
